title: hieracium arragonense subsp. catolanum
intro: Hieracium arragonense subsp. catolanum, commonly known as Cat's Claw Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium arragonense subsp. catolanum may include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and antiproliferative effects, making it a subject of interest in the field of pharmacology. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
